production_plan.title: Anant and the Dawn Dial
production_plan.story_basis: A continuity-focused development of the existing CineAI cosmic-odyssey POC: a lone wanderer, an ancient brass astrolabe, a sapphire prism, and a celestial observatory.
production_plan.story_premise: At blue twilight, Anant discovers a sapphire prism in a ruined desert observatory. Its light guides him across a sandstone ridge to an obsidian chamber, where he aligns the prism with an ancient dial and awakens a beacon. He returns to the salt basin as dawn breaks.

character_bible.Anant: Fictional adult South Asian traveler in his early 30s; medium-brown skin, short black hair, neatly trimmed beard; the same weathered indigo hooded coat, charcoal scarf, dark trousers, brown leather gloves, and small brass satchel in every shot.
character_bible.supporting_characters: None. Do not introduce other people, duplicate Anant, or change his appearance.
character_bible.prop_bible: One palm-sized translucent sapphire prism with fine gold filaments; one weathered brass astrolabe with a single movable ring fixed at the surface observatory lintel; a separate basalt dial in the inner chamber with one carved stone ring and a central prism socket. Anant keeps the prism after shot 8.

visual_continuity_bible.setting: One connected desert region: reflective salt basin, its half-buried sandstone observatory, a red sandstone ridge, an obsidian arch, and the observatory's underground dial chamber.
visual_continuity_bible.palette_and_light: Indigo and slate-blue twilight, restrained cyan from the prism, warm brass and gold highlights; progress naturally from twin-moon twilight to a thin golden dawn.
visual_continuity_bible.environment: Dry salt wind at the basin, red dust on the ridge, cold mist below the bridge, still dust-filled air underground, then easing wind at dawn. No rain or abrupt weather changes.
visual_continuity_bible.style: Cinematic photorealistic grounded fantasy, natural stone and cloth textures, restrained camera movement, landscape 720x480 framing, no text, logos, or visual overlays.

transitions.duration_formula: 30 x 2.0 seconds raw - 2 fades x 0.5 seconds overlap = 59.0 seconds.

generation_contract.reference_handling: required_previous_shot_reference values identify editorial continuity dependencies by shot number. They are not file paths. The current CogVideoX text-to-video provider does not consume previous-video or image references; prompts therefore repeat the character and prop anchors.
